$comment: Read by `npm run beta:supply-chain`. Two kinds of exception, both deliberately awkward to add.
`advisories` accepts a NON-blocking production advisory. `high` and `critical` cannot be
accepted here at all — the gate fails on them regardless of what this file says. Every entry
needs a `reason` and an `expires`; an expired entry FAILS, so an acceptance is a decision with
a review date rather than a permanent one. An entry for an advisory the audit no longer
reports also fails, because a standing acceptance of a fixed problem reads as coverage.
`unreferencedDependencies` excuses a production dependency that no source file imports. Four
of these turned out to be genuinely unused — `openai`, `express`, `cors`, `dotenv` — and were
removed rather than listed. An entry here means the package is required by something other
than an import: the Angular runtime, or a version pin that satisfies an adf-core peer. If the
package becomes referenced, or stops being a dependency, its entry fails as unnecessary.

quill.reason: GHSA-v3m3-f69x-jf25 — XSS via Quill's HTML export, affecting quill = 2.0.3, which is what we run and is the latest published release (verified against the registry: there is nothing to upgrade to). Not reachable as configured: every path that renders note HTML sanitises first. note-editor.ts:502-503 reads getSemanticHTML() and passes it through DOMPurify.sanitize() before returning; document-detail.ts:1862 and :3394 render note HTML through renderTrustedHtml(), which sanitises before bypassing. getSemanticHTML()'s only other caller, note-editor.ts:484, compares the value for equality and discards it. Enforced by sanitizer-audit.mjs check 5, which walks the AST to require a sanitise call paired with every bypassSecurityTrustHtml. Revisit on the next Quill release or when the editor is replaced.
$corrections: Re-reviewed 2026-09-11 because the previous entry was wrong in every verifiable particular while its conclusion was right — the most believable kind of stale acceptance, and one this gate cannot catch, since it matches entries by package name and never reads the GHSA or the line numbers.

It cited GHSA-4943-9vgg-gr5r, a 2021 advisory affecting quill <= 1.3.7. We run 2.0.3, so that advisory does not apply to this repository at all, and the advisory that does — GHSA-v3m3-f69x-jf25, published 2026-01-13 — was therefore accepted by accident rather than by decision.
All four source pointers were stale: document-detail.ts:1694 and :3133 are an unrelated collection check and a lock comment; note-editor.ts:89 and :95 are an imageUploading signal and an editor ref.

It named the guardrail `checkSanitizerPairing`. That was not a false claim when written, but it is now: the check was deliberately removed and superseded by sanitizer-audit.mjs check 5, which is AST-based rather than regex-based. The protection is real and stronger; only the name was wrong.

unreferencedDependencies.tslib: Emitted helper library. The TypeScript compiler generates imports of it into the build output; no source file names it.
unreferencedDependencies.@angular/animations: Required by @angular/material at runtime for its transitions. Never imported by our source.
unreferencedDependencies.@angular/material-date-fns-adapter: Version pin only. @alfresco/adf-core declares it as an unbounded `>=` peer, so without an exact pin a clean install floats it to the Angular 22 line and the build dies with `Unsupported enum value`. See docs/adf-hx-upstream-findings.md 2.1.
unreferencedDependencies.@mat-datetimepicker/core: Version pin only, and one of the two that deliberately differ from adf-core's suggestion: its major track is offset from Angular's, so 16.0.1 is correct for Angular 20.
unreferencedDependencies.date-fns: Version pin only, to keep @angular/material-date-fns-adapter and adf-core agreeing on one copy.
unreferencedDependencies.pdfjs-dist: Version pin only, and the second deliberate deviation: 4.x downgrades a shared native package, so 6.2.108 is pinned.
unreferencedDependencies.minimatch: Version pin only. Declared as a `>=10.0.0` peer by @alfresco/adf-core.
unreferencedDependencies.angular-oauth2-oidc: Version pin only. A direct dependency of @alfresco/adf-core; pinned here so a clean install cannot float it.
unreferencedDependencies.cropperjs: Version pin only. A direct dependency of @alfresco/adf-core; pinned here so a clean install cannot float it.
